summary: Full backend + frontend regression of RouteMail bulk-warmup feature. 21/21 backend pytest cases pass (auth, empty-list 400, clamping, state transitions, cross-user isolation, single-account legacy endpoints, build_warmup_body variation, WARMUP_SUBJECTS RTM marker, GET /accounts new fields). Frontend e2e via Playwright: drip.tester login, /accounts page bulk toolbar, Select All, combined-stats, Start Warmup dialog, Pause, Resume, accounts switch to Active • Day 1.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 7120 lines — far over the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into modules (auth, accounts, warmup, campaigns, billing, admin) in a future refactor pass.
build_warmup_body() does `import random` inside the function body; module-level import is cleaner and slightly faster on hot path (run_warmup_worker calls it many times).
Bulk endpoints silently return matched=0 when caller does not own any of the requested account_ids (good for cross-user isolation), but consider logging this case to detect probing/abuse.

Frontend EmailAccounts.jsx toggleSelectAll empties the selection when all are already selected — correct behaviour but combined with auto-hidden bulk action buttons it can confuse users; consider a separate explicit 'Clear' affordance (already exists as bulk-clear-selection, OK).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login, bulk toolbar, select-all, combined-stats, bulk start dialog, pause, resume verified)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_bulk_warmup.py is reusable as regression. It auto-loads BASE_URL from frontend/.env if env var not set. GET /api/accounts returns {accounts:[], limit_info:{}} (not a plain list) — use the _accounts_list helper. After a full run the 3 bulk.test.* accounts end up disabled; re-enabling tests will re-activate them.
